regime.basis: S3,S2: Fed in a hiking cycle, Dec 9 25bp hike ~94-99% priced; core PCE 3.3% y/y vs 3.2% forecast, Q3 GDP 4.3% vs 3.4% (growth strong, inflation hot, liquidity tightening). S4,S3: AI-led equity weakness with defensive rotation, new tariff proposals on 14 partners (+20% China). S5: US-Iran war / Hormuz shipping attacks keep oil bid.

tilts.basis: S2,S3: hiking cycle with hot core PCE; 10y ~4.84-4.93%, 30y 5.3% (S4); duration still exposed to hike repricing.
S3,S4: AI trade weakening, rate-hike pricing cited as driver of the tech selling.
S4,S5: gold -2.6% on Nov 24 on firm USD/hike bets, offset by Hormuz geopolitics; no edge either way.
S3: Dow erased drop on AI stocks; Fri half-day, last Fed speaking day before blackout; thin liquidity.

calendar.read: S3 reports core PCE already printed Nov 25 (3.3% y/y, above 3.2% forecast); S1 still lists 11-27 rows; treat as already digested. US cash markets shut Nov 26 (Thanksgiving), early close Nov 27 18:00 GMT.
First jobs print before the Dec 9 FOMC; strong labour data keeps the hike (and a possible 50bp tail, ~4% per S2-era FedWatch) live.
25bp hike to 4.00-4.25% near fully priced (S3); risk is the dots and guidance for early 2027 tightening.
Day after FOMC; no consensus in S1.

events.summary: White House/USTR proposes tariffs on 14 trading partners, +20% on China; formal unveiling expected this week.
Shipping attacks near Hormuz and stalled US-Iran diplomacy; WTI +2.4% to ~82 on Nov 24.

no_trade_reason: No verified current daily-bar panel (closes/ATR) for the desk symbols was available to this lane, so any entry/stop/TP levels would be fabricated; US cash markets are shut today (Thanksgiving) and Fri is a half-day; the regime call is low-confidence and the catalysts (NFP Dec 4, FOMC Dec 9) are 1-2 weeks out.
